run_gyp_uv_build: run gyp_uv.py to generate makefiles for the libuv project with default settings
run_host_arch_detection: run host_arch function to detect and return the current machine architecture as a gyp-compatible string
run_gyp_with_args: run gyp.main with a list of arguments and exit on non-zero return code
run_gyp_uv_ninja: run gyp_uv.py with ninja generator flag to produce ninja build files for libuv
run_gyp_uv_custom_arch: run gyp_uv.py with custom host_arch and target_arch definitions for cross-compilation
